Title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
Writer: Dan Hageman, Kevin Hageman, Guillermo del Toro
Actors: Zoe Colletti, Michael Garza, Gabriel Rush
Plot: Pennsylvania, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.
Country: United States, Canada, Mexico, Hong Kong
